description: 30-round adversarial red-team audit of the hackathon pipeline. In each round, the auditor generates a brutal, multi-point teardown from the perspective of Pied Piper, Man In Black, or Chaos Monkey, and THEN implements the fixes for all identified flaws.

userStories.title: Audit Round 1: Pied Piper Teardown & Fix
userStories.description: Round 1 of 30. Adopt the Pied Piper persona. Analyze the architecture for cultural immersion breakers, nuanced LLM generation artifacts, persona voice consistency violations, and things that make the corpus feel fake. Generate a merciless, multi-point teardown of ALL flaws you find. After generating the teardown, implement the fixes for all identified flaws, verify tests pass, and update progress.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate a full Pied Piper teardown listing multiple flaws
Implement fixes for all flaws identified in the teardown
uv run pytest hackathon/ -q passes
Log the teardown and the implemented fixes to .ralph-tui/progress.md
